method: The decision rests on the standing-guard takedown takes (candidate 1214cs, harness 1254h and its stance-aware 1254l) under the product controller with natural guard AI and the NPC stream on: each case waits until Dunwall tutorial guard 2 stands still at his long patrol pause, holds the free camera 3.6 m ahead of him looking back, places the crouched source behind him, 0.85 m to either side (0.4 m back) or 1 m in front facing him, and holds the choke. The source must play a native choke takedown, the partner must present every census scene it played, both worlds must agree the guard is unconscious and the victim must end within 2 m in both worlds; the checkpoint is reloaded after every case. Takes: takedown-variants-v1254i (back), v1254h (sides and Corvo's front), v1254j (Emily's right side), v1254l (Emily's front; 1254h/j failed because B toggles crouch and stood her up in the guard's view). The guard breaking free (choke_combat_lose) is struggle_and_escape.

items.scope: Chokes from behind (choke_back), the left and right sides (choke_left/choke_right) and the front (choke_front), each followed by choke_loop and choke_win, in both source roles: presented on the partner and the guard unconscious in both worlds at the same place.

visual.verdict: Emily takes the guard from behind, holds him in the choke while he struggles and lowers him to the floor.
Emily comes in at the guard's left side, wraps him in the choke and lowers him unconscious.
Corvo seizes the guard from his left side, holds him through the struggle and lets him sag to the floor.
Corvo grabs the guard from the right, holds the choke while the guard kicks, and lowers him.
Emily steps in from the guard's right and chokes him; he folds to the floor beside her.
Corvo seizes the guard face to face; the guard sinks to the floor in front of him (partly hidden behind Corvo).
Emily faces the guard, seizes him and holds the choke, then lowers him to the floor.
